An '''office suite''' was a room on the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] for [[Architect/Legends|architects]] that were in the stages of designing the uncompleted Death Star. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], at the close of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], it was destroyed when the entire space station was destroyed by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].
